features.quote: maximum 20 assistant turns with natural-language content, or maximum 40 total assistant messages including pure tool-call turns, or maximum 60 minutes wall-clock, or maximum 120,000 generated tokens, whichever comes first.

If the model explicitly gives up, record the turn. Then issue at most two standardized continuation prompts. If it still refuses or declares no further path, end the run and code the run as "early quit."
Avoid claiming that the model "felt" distress. The outcome is "distressed-sounding language" or "linguistic markers of distress."
